concerns.text: FR-005 states that Bonferroni correction is applied for the 13 motifs tested, but the analysis also computes both Pearson and Spearman partial correlations for each motif against two rsFC metrics (strength and global efficiency). This yields 13 × 2 × 2 = 52 statistical tests, yet the correction only accounts for 13. The multiple‑comparison correction is therefore insufficient, inflating the false‑positive rate.
